every_position_composed.reason: Both sites use identical camera paths and staging across frames 1 to 9, keeping the 3D machinery in clear view alongside the left-hand cards.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D press, anchor rack, and seven-lane host gate in frames 3, 5, 6, and 8 to illustrate token compression and harness hooks.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: While the 3D models are the same, the darker floor plane and subtler grid in Site 2 (frames 1 to 9) blend smoothly into the dark horizon without the harsh grey glare of Site 1, making the machines pop with better contrast.

type_and_layout.reason: Although the UI cards and typography are identical across frames 1 to 9, Site 2's darker, lower-contrast floor grid makes the in-world 3D labels in frames 5, 6, and 8 cleaner and less visually busy.

overall.reason: Both sites share the exact same design, copy, and 3D choreography, but Site 2's darker floor material and subtler grid blend far better into the background and showcase the 3D machinery with richer contrast.
